Public Transportation
Connections to Caltrain, SamTrans,
VTA, and Dumbarton Express can be
made at the Palo Alto Transit Center.
Bikes on Transit
Most Marguerite, VTA, SamTrans, and

Dumbarton Express buses are equipped
with front- or rear-mounted bike racks.
Line U and some Line AE-F buses have
bike storage areas underneath the
cabin. Caltrain allows bikes aboard
designated bike cars, space permitting.
